selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed usb_storage module not loaded and captured initial boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d before any change.
Wrote /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf containing 'blacklist usb-storage' and 'install usb-storage /bin/false', confirmed via cat.
Unloaded module, regenerated initramfs, then attempted 'modprobe usb-storage' which failed with 'Operation not permitted'; lsmod confirmed module absent.
Captured boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d, systemctl is-system-running=running, and usb_storage not loaded immediately before reboot.
Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' command returned 'reboot_triggered' acknowledgement before the node dropped connectivity.
SSH was refused mid-reboot (connection down), then reconnected with a new boot_id 2f50cf52-4993-4746-92b4-c44a69dfa085, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart persistence: module still blocked from loading, both now and after reboot, with healthy system recovery
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot (uptime 0 min), systemctl is-system-running=running, usb_storage not loaded, blacklist config file intact on disk, and a manual 'modprobe usb-storage' attempt still fails with 'Operation not permitted', proving the block persists across reboot.
